LanguageData.ESCP_StorytellerJoin_Text: A lone knight has walked up to your gate and announced himself as {PAWN_nameDef}, sovereign of Anvil. No such emperor exists, and he has no guards, no retinue and no crown. He has decided your colony is a loyal province and would like to stay and inspect it in person.\n\nHe seems sincere. He also seems to know how to use that sword.
